payload.description:
As a scanner evaluator, I want Ruby source files to be eligible for personal-data and data-action analysis, so that Rails privacy behavior is represented consistently.

Feature: Ruby privacy-action support

Scenario: Evaluate Rails source
  Given a Ruby on Rails source file containing personal-data handling
  When scanner evaluation and deterministic data-action rules run
  Then Ruby is eligible for personal-data layers
  And conservative Rails collection, storage, erasure, return, logging, and supported outbound disclosure patterns are detected

Out of scope: Ruby parser/detector/pattern config, manifests/pipeline, benchmark annotations.
payload.title: Ruby privacy actions are evaluated
